observations: marker_ammo: Three tall amber cartridge towers in a shallow fan; the center is tallest. Wide anchored foot, gaps above the lower manifold.
marker_health: Asymmetric rounded teal organ suspended in a low ivory basin, open side gap and a narrow overhead return pipe. Avoid a symmetric capsule.
marker_armor: Broad cobalt layered crescent wings; the upper center is cut away and the ivory inner rim follows a deep U aperture.
marker_key: Slender vertical fork, two blood-red blades with an open central slot, ivory lower ribs and a compact central circular lock.
marker_weapon: Low wide ivory U cradle around two horizontal parallel dark barrels. Visible muzzle holes and upper void distinguish it from ammo.
marker_story: Two tall pale outward-flared codex leaves separated by a dark vertical split and a narrow luminous spine; no filled rectangular plaque.
marker_checkpoint: Three separated tapering legs surround an amber suspended spherical core and cross-ring. The rear leg needs depth separation in the three-quarter preview.
marker_exit: Wide open upper ring descends through progressively smaller coils toward the ground; ivory frame and muted violet inner bands. Preserve visible spaces between levels.
